criteria: 能算出分数乘分数
能约分后再写得数
set.description: 会计算分数乘分数，用分子相乘的积做分子，分母相乘的积做分母。
set.name: Multiplying Fractions by Fractions

criteria: 能说出除以一个分数等于乘它的倒数
能算出分数除法并约分
set.description: 会计算分数除以分数，等于乘除数的倒数。
set.name: Fraction division

criteria: 能把分子分母同时乘一个数
能说出分数大小不变
set.description: 知道分子和分母同时乘或除以相同的数（0 除外），分数大小不变。
set.name: Basic Property of Fractions

criteria: 能把「一个数的几分之几」写成乘法
能算出结果并约分
set.description: 能用分数乘法求一个数的几分之几是多少。
set.name: Applications of Fraction Multiplication

criteria: 能把十分之几写成一位小数
能把一位小数写成十分之几
set.description: 会把分母是 10、100 的分数写成小数，也会把有限小数写成分数。
set.name: Converting Between Fractions and Decimals

criteria: 能说出百分数表示的是两个数的倍比关系
能读出一个百分数
set.description: 理解百分数表示一个数是另一个数的百分之几。
set.name: Meaning of percentages

criteria: 能算出分数乘整数
能把结果约成最简分数
set.description: 会计算分数乘整数，用分子乘整数做新的分子，分母不变。
set.name: Multiplying Fractions by Integers

criteria: 能说出除以一个整数等于乘它的倒数
能算出分数除以整数
set.description: 会计算分数除以整数，等于乘这个整数的倒数。
set.name: Dividing fractions by integers

set.reason: The integer-multiplier case supplies a useful stepping stone and repeated-addition interpretation. The product-of-numerators/product-of-denominators rule follows directly from a part-of-a-part area model without executing the earlier decimal-free integer-multiplier procedure; Gemini confuses this customary progression with necessity.
set.scope: generalizing the product rule

set.reason: The integer-divisor case provides familiar reciprocal-rule practice. A general fraction-divisor rule can instead be derived directly by equalizing units or solving the defining multiplication relation; Gemini's customary first-lesson order does not make that earlier special-case procedure a necessary step.
set.scope: extending the reciprocal rule to fractional divisors

set.reason: Fraction division prepares ratio values with fractional terms. The target expressly permits a simple ratio, and a whole-number pair such as 6 to 3 needs only ordinary division; no fraction-by-fraction division is universal.
set.scope: ratio values with fractional terms

set.reason: The hundredths-to-decimal correspondence is directly used in percent/decimal conversion. Only that conversion component is required, not every fraction/decimal conversion exercise.
set.scope: percent to decimal and back via hundredths

set.reason: Writing a percent as hundredths uses what the percent sign means as a relative quantity per hundred.
set.scope: converting between percents, fractions and decimals

set.reason: The stated criterion allows decimal or fraction conversion before multiplying. Decimal multiplication satisfies it without the fraction multiplication procedure. Gemini makes the optional fraction representation universal; the analogous fraction-of model is useful preparation only.
set.scope: Fraction-of-a-quantity modeling as preparation for percent-of calculations

set.reason: The criterion explicitly first converts the percent to a decimal or fraction and then multiplies; the conversion is therefore a required step in this stated procedure.
set.scope: converting the percent before multiplying

criteria: 能把百分之几化成小数或分数再乘
能算出结果
set.description: 会求一个数的百分之几是多少。
set.name: Finding a percentage of a number

criteria: 能说出比的前项除以后项是比值
能求一个简单的比的比值
set.description: 理解比表示两个数相除的关系，比的前项除以后项叫做比值。
set.name: Meaning of Ratios

criteria: 能把百分数化成小数
能把小数化成百分数
set.description: 会把百分数化成分数或小数，也会把小数化成百分数。
